description.zh: 快照一致性组所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 快照一致性组ID。您可以调用[DescribeSnapshotGroups](~~210940~~)查询快照一致性组ID。
description.en: The ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call [DescribeSnapshotGroups](~~210940~~) to query snapshot-consistent group IDs.

descriptions.zh: 如果快照一致性组中的云盘快照已经用于创建自定义镜像，则快照一致性组删除时相关的云盘快照不会被删除。您如果需要删除相关的云盘快照，请先删除已创建的自定义镜像（[DeleteImage](~~25537~~)），再删除相关的云盘快照（[DeleteSnapshot](~~25525~~)）。
descriptions.en: If disk snapshots in a snapshot-consistent group have been used to create custom images, the related disk snapshots are not deleted when the snapshot-consistent group is deleted. To delete the related disk snapshots, first delete the custom images ([DeleteImage](~~25537~~)), and then delete the related disk snapshots ([DeleteSnapshot](~~25525~~)).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-snapshot-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --snapshot-group-id ssg-j6c9lpuyxo2uxxny0000 --region cn-hangzhou
